keyPhrases.text: Best of all is Jeremy Strong's Dr. Thomas Stockmann
Herzog's rewriting... is a vast improvement
what we all endured in real life... was so much more dramatic than what's being offered onstage
what Herzog and Gold have turned it into agitprop
his recent interpretations... have taken their knocks for being far too eccentric

reasoning: Mixed-positive review with strong praise for Strong's performance and some production elements, but criticism of the adaptation's heavy-handed political parallels. The tone is generally favorable with wit and appreciation for specific aspects, placing it in the 4-star range despite reservations.
